items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: We used to have some sessions... that's how I run into Stuff Smith, they used to be in there jamming, Eddie South, Shramea Young.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, I've seen quite a few of them. I never saw any of these women around New Orleans do that, but around New York, Chicago, they could do it. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. But, uh. We used to have some sessions, as I started to tell you about that, that's how I run into Stuff Smith, they used to be in there jamming, Eddie South, Shramea Young. Where was this? At the Big Apple in New York. Yeah. They used to come in there around one, two o'clock in the morning. Sometimes we'd have as much as 15, 20 pieces in there.…
